title: Marco Rubio says there's "zero evidence" linking the recent FAA ground stop, Microsoft outage, and bank service issues, and the US isn't "under systemic attack" (Kiki Intarasuwan/CBS News)
summary: Kiki Intarasuwan / CBS News: Marco Rubio says there's “zero evidence” linking the recent FAA ground stop, Microsoft outage, and bank service issues, and the US isn't “under systemic attack” — Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there's “zero evidence” that recent tech outages in U.S. air travel, banking and other systems are connected.
contentText:
Kiki Intarasuwan / CBS News :

Marco Rubio says there's “zero evidence” linking the recent FAA ground stop, Microsoft outage, and bank service issues, and the US isn't “under systemic attack”   —  Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there's “zero evidence” that recent tech outages in U.S. air travel, banking and other systems are connected.
